title: Auditing Return Conditioning as a Control Knob: An Offline Diagnostic for Decision Transformer Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.24815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline return-to-go (RTG) sweeps can test whether a recommender conditioned on return is controllable, but the intervention is rarely audited. Rewriting every historical RTG token creates an increasingly synthetic context, while rewriting only the current token is more local. We test this distinction in an offline setting with a fixed window. On MovieLens 25M and MyAnimeList 2020 (MAL), we evaluate a Decision Transformer using an RTG locality ladder, a control without RTG, a logged match and score reward check, and a within-trajectory shuffled RTG ablation. translated_title: 审计返回条件作为控制旋钮：决策变换器推荐的离线诊断方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24815v1 公告类型：新 摘要：离线返回目标（RTG）扫描可以测试以返回为条件的推荐器是否可控，但这种干预很少被审计。重写每个历史RTG标记会创建越来越合成的上下文，而仅重写当前标记则更局部。我们在固定窗口的离线环境中测试了这一区别。在MovieLens 25M和MyAnimeList 2020（MAL）上，我们使用RTG局部性阶梯、无RTG的对照、记录匹配和分数奖励检查，以及轨迹内打乱的RTG消融来评估决策变换器。在MovieLens上，$K=20$的干预覆盖整个上下文，仅应用于真实上下文位置，将犯罪预测的份额从验证集的第5百分位移动到第95百分位，变化为$+23.61 \pm 2.96$个百分点，而仅更改当前槽位则变化为$+1.77 \pm 1.17$个百分点。打乱的RTG模型在很大程度上消除了这种响应（在$K=20$时变化为$+2.08 \pm 1.20$个百分点）。
tldr: 本文提出一种离线审计方法，证明在决策变换器推荐中，全面重写RTG上下文比仅修改当前标记能显著增强推荐可控性，且打乱RTG会消除这种效应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an offline auditing method showing that fully rewriting RTG context in decision transformer recommendations significantly enhances controllability over modifying only the current token, with shuffled RTG eliminating this effect.
